note: Brainstorm drafts agreed with the owner. NOT applied anywhere. Apply only when the owner says we are ready.

drafts.R001: If a banner is present, is at least 30% of it visible and readable? Blocking by people and minor creases are fine.
drafts.R001_FLAT: Is the banner free from crumpling so severe that its words cannot be read? Ordinary folds, creases and soft ripples are fine.
drafts.R001_POSITION: Is the entire banner, judged by its assumed boundary even where people or objects hide part of it, within the frame of the photo?
drafts.R002: Volunteers giving something to a beneficiary should wear white tops.
drafts.F_VOLUNTEERS: Is at least one volunteer visible in this photo? A volunteer is a person wearing a white top, or a person giving something to a beneficiary.
drafts.R002_GIVER_WHITE: Is every person who is giving something to a beneficiary wearing a white top?
drafts.F_BENEFICIARIES: Is at least one beneficiary visible in this photo? A beneficiary is any person not wearing a white top, whether or not they are receiving anything (they may already have received something, be next in line, or just be standing there). A person receiving something from a volunteer is also a beneficiary. A person giving something to a beneficiary is a volunteer, whatever they wear. An animal can also be a beneficiary.
drafts.R003_FACE: Is some part of every person's face visible, even if turned partly away: not covered, hidden or in shadow, and, for the main people, not too small to read?
drafts.R004_GENUINE: Do the expressions and interactions look genuine, in a candid moment rather than staged or posed?
drafts.R006_SIZE: Are the main people and the seva activity clearly visible: large enough in the frame and not blocked from view?
drafts.R006_ACTION: Is a seva activity actually taking place (for example giving food, teaching, treating, caring for an animal), not just people standing or waiting?
drafts.R007: Choose an angle that captures the activity from the same level. Avoid awkward perspectives, tilted frames and angles that obstruct the subject. A very high or very low angle is not allowed; a slightly higher or lower angle is fine.
drafts.R007_ANGLE: Is the activity captured from roughly the same level as the people (a slightly higher or lower angle is fine, a very high or very low angle is not), with a level frame, so that the activity is clearly visible and not obstructed?
drafts.R007_CUTOFF: Is everything important fully inside the frame: no key person, hands or objects cut off at the edges or hidden by the camera angle?
drafts.R007_PLACEMENT: Is the main subject sensibly placed in the frame (not squeezed into a corner or edge) and free from obstruction by people or objects in front of it?
drafts.R003_FACE_SHARP: Is every person's face sharp and in focus (not blurred by motion or poor focus)?
drafts.R008: Show people from the front or the side. Nobody should be shown fully from behind: some part of the face should be visible.
drafts.R008_BACK: Is every person seen from the front or the side, with some part of the face visible (nobody shown fully from behind)?
drafts.R011_BACKGROUND: Is the background free from clutter, scattered materials and unrelated objects that draw attention away from the seva?
drafts.R012_DIGNITY: Does the photograph maintain the dignity of everyone involved?
drafts.R013_HUMANITY: Does the photograph reflect the spirit of humanity and compassion?
drafts.R010_TECHNICAL (NEW soft gate, id to be: Is the photo technically sound: sharp and in focus, free from camera shake, motion blur, heavy grain and pixelation, and well exposed and well lit (not too dark, not too bright, no washed-out or blacked-out areas, no harsh backlight, heavy shadows or glare hiding detail)?
drafts.F_ITEM_GIVEN: Is an item being handed over in this photo? An item is any substance, such as food, a packet, a sack or similar packed goods, medicine or a book, that is being given by a person's hands and received by a beneficiary's hands, whatever the giver is wearing. Only a visible hand-to-hand handover counts: people who are only interacting, standing together or talking, paperwork, forms, pamphlets or brochures, registration or checking of documents, and things lying on a table are not an item being handed over.
drafts.R015_BEN_RECEIVING: If an item is being given, is at least one beneficiary receiving it (or already holding it)?
drafts.R006_ITEM_SHARP: If an item is being handed over, is the item sharp and in focus and clear enough to recognise? A sack or similar packed goods count as items, and their contents need not be visible.

order_wishes: R001_POSITION should be listed before the banner visibility rules (check the banner is within the frame first, then its visibility). Order has little effect on the verdict; set at apply time.
to_review_with_gates: REQUIREMENT (owner): R001_POSITION must be the FIRST banner check and must be able to REJECT: if a banner is present and its assumed boundary is not entirely within the frame, the photo is disapproved whatever else is true. Today it has no gate (information only), so this needs a new hard gate for it, applicable only when a banner is present. Not a wording change.
watch_for: R001_VISIBLE (#6) says 'fully in the frame': that duplicates R001_POSITION and should be dropped when #6 is edited.

dress_code_agreed: 2026-11-05. The ONLY rejection in this group: a person giving something to a beneficiary is not wearing a white top (gate G013, R002_GIVER_WHITE, applicable only when someone is giving; Q1 F_VOLUNTEERS is information only and never rejects). Bottoms (jeans etc.) and neatness are no longer checked. Check at apply time: F_VOLUNTEERS is also used by other rules (e.g. R006_VOLUNTEER_DOING, applicability volunteers_visible), which would get the wider definition of a volunteer.

R015_PERSON_PRESENT (gate G014, kept: the only gate that rejects a photo with no relevant subject)

R015_BEN_RECEIVING decided 2026-11-05: 'at least some beneficiary should receive the item' (only when an item is being given); gate G012 kept
face_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. Beneficiary = every person not in a white top (even bystanders / next in line), plus anyone receiving something, plus animals; a giver is always a volunteer whatever they wear (precedence: giving > receiving > white top). Face-visible (G004) and sharpness (G006) can reject; lighting is information only until the lighting rules are reviewed. NOTE: today's F_BENEFICIARIES says 'decide from role in the activity only, never from appearance': the new definition uses clothing, so that sentence goes. Other rules use F_BENEFICIARIES, F_ANIMALS, F_VOLUNTEER_GIVER: check at apply time. Crowded photos with a turned-away bystander will reject more.
gaze_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. No gaze gate at all for now: beneficiaries and volunteers may look into the camera. To be added back later only if the human checker's feedback asks for it (the loop's analyst can propose it). The merged genuine/candid/interaction rule is information only.
activity_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. R006_SIZE (main people only, not all people) becomes a rejecting gate; R006_ITEM_SHARP unchanged; R006_ACTION info only. Face-visible wording in the earlier group is unchanged (still has 'in shadow' and 'too small'): possible overlap with R006_SIZE to revisit on real photos.
angle_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. Angle gate rejects a very high AND a very low angle (confirmed by owner). Slightly higher/lower is fine.
back_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. R008_BACK (G016): every beneficiary from the front; volunteers need some part of the face visible. R003_FACE keeps only covered/hidden/shadow/too small (main people). No redundancy between the two.
lighting_group_agreed: 2026-11-05 (revised): R009 and R010 client lines stay as reference; ONE soft gate R010_TECHNICAL covers focus, blur, grain, exposure, lighting; the degree decides (very bad = stop/RESELECT). R009_FACE_LIT, DIRECTION, LIT, OVEREXPOSED, PEOPLE_LIT, UNDEREXPOSED, R010_GRAIN, R010_SHAKE removed. R003_LIGHT removed (agreed). 'Stop' = RESELECT (agreed); keep the 0-4 technical_quality scale with the cap at 2 (agreed).
sharpness_background_dignity_agreed: 2026-11-05. R011: client line + one question R011_BACKGROUND (info only). R012_DIGNITY and R013_HUMANITY: one answered rule each, information only (owner: dignity info only for now). R014/R015 client lines removed.
extras_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. Of the 16 proposed extras (NEW-008..022, P004) only NEW-014 stays; glare and pixelation are folded into the R010_TECHNICAL wording. NEXT: scene facts (#97-111) and the four GUIDE lines, which now contradict the agreed rules (GUIDE_01 back view, GUIDE_02 gaze).
guidance_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. All four GUIDE lines removed. NEXT: the 15 scene facts (#97-111).
facts_group_agreed: 2026-11-05. 8 facts kept, 7 removed; F_VOLUNTEER_GIVER merged into F_ITEM_GIVEN (reworded). Review of #1-#115 FINISHED (R015_BEN_RECEIVING decided).
gates_review_agreed: 2026-11-05. Final gates: 11 hard (G001, G003, G004, G006, G009, G012, G013, G014, G016, G017, G019) + 2 soft (size, technical quality). Removed: G002, G005, G007, G008, G010, G011, G015. G001 loses its 4 components; G016 keeps only R008_BACK. G004/G006 apply to every person; G012 and G013 apply when an item is being given (merged fact). Tests that pin '16 hard gates' must be updated. Owner: the AI must always give a verdict (no 'human review' as a way out) while a person decides every photo; the policy mapping below is awaiting confirmation.
verdict_policy_agreed: 2026-11-05, owner: 'keep it as some result, these will get corrected after the human gives its result'. The AI always gives a verdict; HUMAN_REVIEW is no longer an AI outcome. (1) a hard gate answered CANNOT_TELL -> REJECT with the reason 'could not confirm'; (2) one quality cutoff at 70, below -> RESELECT; (3) publication blocked -> REJECT naming the blocker. A person still decides every photo; the human's verdict corrects the AI. Needs an engine change in decision_engine.py (steps 2, 3 and 4) and tests.
item_definition_agreed: 2026-11-06, owner (after the 20-photograph test): an ITEM is any substance given by a volunteer's hands and received by a beneficiary's hands; a sack or sack-like packed goods count as items and need not show their contents; a photograph that is only an interaction (no handover) has no item given, so G003 / G012 / G013 do not apply. Seen on approved_59 (a sack) and approved/approved_10 (an interaction), which Haiku rejected under the old wording. 2026-11-06 later: owner agreed (after approved/approved_10 was still read as a handover) that paperwork, forms, pamphlets or brochures, registration or checking of documents, and things lying on a table are NOT an item being handed over; only a visible hand-to-hand handover counts. Consequence accepted: an activity that hands out pamphlets as its item has no item given, so G003, G012 and G013 skip it.
loosening_agreed: 2026-11-06, owner ('Loosen them') after approved/approved_10 was still rejected: the beneficiary was seen from the side and turned away. The face gate (G004) and the back gate (G016) now accept a face turned partly away if some of it can be seen; only a person shown FULLY from behind fails, beneficiaries and volunteers alike. This replaces 'every beneficiary from the front'. Wording chosen by Claude as the smallest loosening of the two options offered (the other: apply the face and back gates to the main beneficiary only): owner may still change it. Not re-measured on photographs.
